claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: If g is bent on even k>=8 variables, h is obtained by flipping any two distinct truth-table points, and a fresh d-bit one-word selector chooses h with probability p=2^-d and g otherwise, then U(F)-(1-p)U(g)-pU(h)<283 I_ctl(F).
claims.quantifiers: Every even k>=8, every bent Boolean g, every distinct x,y, every d>=1, every Hamming separation and phase.
limitations: One selector node only; no arbitrary changing-core hierarchy.
No no-double-spend theorem for three or more overlapping displacement filters.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: In the complete shared-selector charge, the long-log correction p(1-p)[Udiff(e)-sum_T e_T^2(k-|T|)] is nonpositive for every two-point edit, including r=1 and both phase signs.

claims.label: EXACT_AND_HIGH_PRECISION_CORROBORATION
claims.statement: The checker passed 5422518 assertions in 1242 direct truth-table cases and 756 theorem-range cases; maximum observed J/I_ctl was 5.106568427546.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: No universal GU' estimate, full FEI proof, or genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded H/I is established.
